name: Treasury clearing mandate

test1.method: No statistical test; confirm each milestone has a public source

milestones.event: SEC extends Treasury clearing compliance dates by one year (Release No. 34-102487)
sources: https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2025-03-04/html/2025-03351.htm (90 FR 11134-11139; local copy data/raw/Federal Register, Volume 90 Issue 41 (Tuesday, March 4, 2025).pdf)
milestones.quote: "Specifically, the Commission is extending the compliance dates by one year, from December 31, 2025, to December 31, 2026, for eligible cash market transactions, and from June 30, 2026, to June 30, 2027, for eligible repo transactions." (Summary, 90 FR 11134-11135; "Dated: February 25, 2025", 90 FR 11139). Effective date of the release: March 4, 2025.

test2.method: Descriptive (D8): mean daily Sponsored TOTAL_AMOUNT, 60 business days before vs after each past milestone

table.event: SEC extends Treasury clearing compliance dates by one year (Release No. 34-102487)

all_splits_distribution.note: overlapping windows on an upward-trending series; descriptive only, no pass/fail. Days before 2021-10-12 (12 zero days in Aug 2021, then ~$0.05-0.5bn/day) excluded as a source-coverage artefact.

vulnerability.variable: Top-5 share of client transactions (PQD 19.1.3.2, avg)
vulnerability.use: scoring only; not used in Test 2

confidence: Low/Medium (no market indicator; logic + cases, pending owner verification)
